# Excel Physical Medicine and Rehab

> Physician-led physical medicine and rehabilitation (PM&R / physiatry) practice in Novi, Michigan. Focused on the prevention, diagnosis, and non-operative management of pain and disability. Also known as Excel PM&R.

- Address: 31190 Novi Road, Novi, MI 48377 (single location)
- Phone: 248.624.5176 | Fax: 248.624.5314
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., or by appointment
- Physician: Dr. Augustus (Peter) Evangelista, MD, MBA, NHA, board certified in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation and in Pain Medicine; Medical Director
- Accepted payors: Auto, Workers Compensation, Medicare, Blue Cross, HAP, United, Priority, other commercial insurance
- Not affiliated with other businesses using the "Excel" name in other states

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.excel-rehab.com/): Overview of the practice
- [About Dr. Evangelista](https://www.excel-rehab.com/about): Credentials, training, hospital affiliations, approach
- [Services](https://www.excel-rehab.com/services): On-site physical therapy, peripheral joint, trigger point, epidural steroid, facet joint, sacroiliac joint, PRP and ultrasound-guided injections, therapeutic Botox, regenerative medicine
- [Conditions We Treat](https://www.excel-rehab.com/conditions): Neck and back pain, herniated discs, radiculopathy, arthritis, sports injuries, whiplash, spasticity, and more
- [Accepted Insurance](https://www.excel-rehab.com/patient-resources): Payor sources
- [Contact](https://www.excel-rehab.com/contact): Scheduling, directions, phone
